plan.python_test: 2019 Feb-Apr only, following frozen 2017-18 fit and validation
plan.eligibility: D0 unique second + >=1 later; D25/D50 hide maximal complete prefix up to floor(q*N), require hidden batch and >=3 later. All depths abstain if <3 roster-visible or <12 legal. Missing author or abstention scores zero.
plan.comparison: all eligible, common roots, common ready. D50 matches historical mask; D0 uses stricter shared abstention.
plan.sim: 98-day closed roster, Dept2 4 / Enron 8 windows. 160 coupled attempts per cell/window. 2x2 uniform vs active first sender, symmetric second uniform vs unique first activation. D0 and D50.
plan.sim_roles: 28/98-day sends, counts of root/first activation in 80 auxiliary historical cascades per completed fortnight in 98 days, mean incoming/outgoing 28-day contacts. Role-wise conditional likelihood on earlier Dept2 only, validation selects penalty; frozen transfer.
plan.prior: one-active unordered correction (wi+wj); first sender actually weighted; imperfect for asymmetric targets
plan.decomposition: common eligible attempts only, equal allocation of interaction across both orders. These are controlled simulated contrasts; real causal shares are unidentified.

bootstrap.units: event-weighted; paired seed and consecutive prespecified window blocks, including empty windows
